title: The US urged G20 members to avoid writing entirely new AI regulations, and instead focus on writing rules for "novel" situations that involve the tech (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: The US urged G20 members to avoid writing entirely new AI regulations, and instead focus on writing rules for “novel” situations that involve the tech — The U.S. pressed G20 members on Tuesday to take a hands-off approach to AI regulation and avoid creating new rules …
contentText:
Reuters :

At G20 meeting the US urged members to avoid writing entirely new AI regulations, while Mark Zuckerberg urged countries not to restrict open-weight AI models   —  The U.S. pressed G20 members on Tuesday to take a hands-off approach to AI regulation and avoid creating new rules for the technology …
